I, Gayantha Karunatilaka, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct.

An allotment of land in total extent of about 0.2946 Hectare,depicted as Lot 'A' in Advance Tracing No. Ya/KPY/2014/42 dated10.05.2014, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys ofJaffna District, situated in the Village of Pattaimeni in the GramaNiladhari Division of Pttaimeni No. J/281, Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Valikamam East of Jaffna District in Northern Provinceand bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Koothathoddam – Extent: 0.2946 HectareNorth: Koothathoddam claimed by Yogampikai Yogaraja andLactsiya Arulanantham; East: Koothathoddam claimed by LactsiyaArulanantham and Vathilingam Retneswari; South: Road (R.D.A.);West: Koothathoddam claimed by Kandasamy Ganesamoorthy.
Gayantha Karunatilaka, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Ref. No. : 4-3/4/2013/D/147.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,‘‘Mihikatha Medura’’,1200/6, Rajamalwaththa Road,Battaramulla.12th June, 2017
